storyCards.headline: Hello It's Me: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
Todd Rundgren's "Hello It's Me" reached #5 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Hello It's Me" is a song written by American musician Todd Rundgren.

It was the first song he wrote, and was recorded by his group Nazz as a slow ballad, released as the B-side of the band's first single, "Open My Eyes", in 1968.

A mid-tempo version, recorded for Rundgren's 1972 solo album Something/Anything?, was issued as a single in 1973, reaching No.

The song peaked at #5 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 20 weeks on the chart.
